figures.label: fig:car_by_action
figures.caption_hint: Mean cumulative abnormal returns (CARs) for KBE by FOMC action type, 2015–2025. Error bars show ±1 SD. Window [-1, 0] trading days.
figures.note: N=21 hikes, N=10 cuts, N=49 holds. Standard deviations shown.

figures.label: fig:car_vs_rate
figures.caption_hint: Relationship between FOMC target rate change and KBE cumulative abnormal return (window [-1, 0]). Fitted line shows regression slope: β̂ = -0.000043 (SE=0.000096, p=0.656).
figures.note: Each point represents the mean CAR for events with that rate change. N=80 events. Fitted regression shown; R²=0.0026.

figures.label: fig:car_dist
figures.caption_hint: Distribution of cumulative abnormal returns (CARs) across three event windows. Each panel shows the empirical distribution of CARs with mean line.

figures.label: fig:reg_coef
figures.caption_hint: Regression coefficient on target rate change (basis points) in predicting KBE CAR, with 95% confidence intervals. Outcome: CAR in window [-1, 0]. The coefficient is not significantly different from zero (p=0.656).
figures.note: 95% CI shown. N=80 events. β̂ = -0.000043 (SE=0.000096, p=0.656). Interpretation: a 25-bp rate increase → -0.107% CAR.
